description: Returns the dates and UK times of spring tides (new and full Moons) and neap tides (first and last quarter Moons) from the Moon's phases, in date order, with the next spring tide and next neap tide first and perigean spring tides flagged. These are tide dates, not times or heights for a port.

count.description: Maximum number of tide dates, from 1 to 24. 8 without it.

from.description: First UK date to include, as YYYY-MM-DD. Without it the list starts right now, or at the start of the year given.

year.description: Calendar year from 1900 to 2100 whose tide dates are listed. Without it the list starts at from, or right now, and runs on into the next year.

name: get_tides
title: Spring and neap tide dates
